scope: Offline, same recorded input history and same S3R2 initial network state. No alternate physical trajectory and no firmware mutation.
precondition: Full binary CRC and duplicate/ABI checks; baseline recorded commands/masks/causes and recurrent final state validation must pass before any ablation results are interpreted.
comparison: Record all360 steps of predictions, actual learning, nodes, repair modes, masks/causes and admitted commands. All branches retained. No adaptive parameter/gain search or automatic preferred branch selection.
negativeControl: Stationary-retention rule must have no effect in this preselected moving-reference window. Failure indicates implementation/configuration mismatch, not a benefit.
scientificBoundary: Fixed measured q/velocity/acceleration/RPM means no simulated closed-loop feedback response. Cannot compute or claim alternative tracking or sync errors from unchanged input states. A changed request or learner alone does not prove improved physical performance.
currentDataset: Two synthetic fixtures only: original repair-active logger test; artificial useful-output pure-rate fixture with seeded negative Y weights and moving reference, specifically exercises classification rather than letting repair conceal it. Neither is physical data. Actual67612 capture unavailable; physical mechanism finding pending.
